items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: I tried to go when Joe Lovano and Gonzalo were there but it was totally sold out both nights so.

ctx.x: They have a nice piano there as a matter of fact.
